title: Adapter Detail Delete Permission Consistency

items.action: delete an adapter from Adapter Detail

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.scraper.delete permission is reused.

backend.reason: Existing adapter delete authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contract changes; the Adapter Detail delete UI is aligned with the existing delete authorization.

audit.reason: Existing adapter deletion behavior is unchanged.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: The adapter detail route remains readable with scraper read permission; only deletion requires scraper delete.

notes: AdapterDetailPage previously exposed deletion to users who could only read adapter details, while DELETE /scraper/adapters/{adapter} requires fair_crm.scraper.delete. Delete now hides and fails closed without delete permission.
